items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Interviewer asks: 'What do you remember about Guitar Slim?' Interviewee responds with details about Guitar Slim's death: 'He was driving down LaSalle Street...'

ctx.x: I was trying to think of some of the places in Chicago. Cause I played in Chicago many times. I don't remember. I don't, I, I don't, I really, I don't. You didn't think I played there? Yeah, it was, but I don't think, I don't think I played there. But, uh, well, there's so many different places to play, you know. Well, I don't, I don't remember, uh, all the places I played. But I do remember being there. I remember playing there. What do you remember about Guitar Slim? Yeah, uh-huh.
Yeah, I remember, he killed himself. You know, Guitar Slim had a Cadillac. Yeah. Yeah.
